A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

Glad you asked.

Here's how Website Ready works.

How can you build my website before I order it?

We research publicly available information about your business, then use it to prepare a personalized website concept. We do that work first so you have something real to look at before deciding.

Do I have to buy the website you made?

No. The preview is there to help you decide. If it's not for you, you don't have to purchase it.

How much does it cost?

The website is $699, paid once. You see your preview before making that purchase.

Is the preview actually built for my business?

If we sent you a personalized preview, yes: it was prepared using information about your business. The fictional examples on this page simply show possible design directions.

What happens if I want the website?

Use the next step provided with your personalized preview, or reply to the message we sent you. We'll confirm the purchase and launch details with you before you proceed.

What if I haven't received a preview?

The examples above are a good place to start. A personalized website is ready for you when we've contacted you with your own preview link.
